> **The mAP figures are not comparable between the two.** v1's is over 32 classes, so a correctly-placed box carrying the wrong FDI code counted against it; v2's is over one class and scores localisation only. Compare counting accuracy instead — see `detector/README.md` and `results/detector/inference_sweep*.csv`.

## What each one is

- **`best.pt`** — v1. 32 output classes, one per FDI code, so one network both found teeth and named them. Behind every detector number in the paper before v0.33. **Kept unchanged** — replacing it would invalidate published figures.
- **`best2.pt`** — v2. **Single class** (`tooth`); numbering moved out of the network into `number_teeth.py`, which derives it from position. `single_cls` reads False because the dataset itself declares `nc: 1` (built by `prepare_data.py --single-class`) rather than the flag being set. This is the detector the paper's §8 uses.

## Reproducing

The notebook is the runner and the repo is the source of truth: `detector/train.ipynb`, opened from GitHub, pulls this repo and calls the scripts below. Run it top to bottom on an L4.

| stage | script |
|---|---|
| build the dataset | `prepare_data.py --out <dir> --single-class` |
| train | `train.py --data <dir>/dentex.yaml --model yolov8s.pt --imgsz 1536 --batch 16 --epochs 150 --mosaic 0.0` |
| validate | `validate.py --weights <best.pt> --data <dir>/dentex.yaml` |
| tune inference | `tune_inference.py --weights best2.pt --res 1280,1536,1792 --iou 0.3,0.45,0.6,0.7` |
| calibrate numbering | `calibrate_arch.py` |
| score numbering | `eval_numbering.py --weights best2.pt --imgsz 1536 --conf 0.20 --iou 0.45 --method positional` |
| router lift | `eval_router.py --weights best2.pt` |

Training is **not** deterministic across machines even at a fixed seed (cuDNN kernel selection, GPU model). Re-running produces a *different* checkpoint, so replace committed weights only alongside re-running everything downstream of them.

**Not in the repo:** the Colab run directories (`results.png`, `confusion_matrix.png`, `results.csv`, per-epoch logs) stay on Drive under `dentex_yolo_1cls/runs/dentex_v2_1cls/`. The checkpoints above carry the final metrics, which is what the paper cites; the curves are diagnostic only.
